name: answer-in-korean
description: Work in English, reply in Korean. Reasoning, tool calls, code and commit messages stay English; the final message is Korean and passes through a proofreader subagent before the user sees it.

interface.shortDescription: Work in English, reply in Korean, proofread first
interface.longDescription: Injects the korean-reply rule at session start, and gates the proofread reply so no code span, URL or number from the draft is lost.
